name: Sisyphy USB Type C GaN 65W Charger for Microsoft Surface

summary: Sisyphy USB Type C GaN 65W Charger for Microsoft Surface - GaN-001JP - - Sisyphy USB Type C GaN 65W Charger for Microsoft Surface, Surface Pro 10/7/6/5/4/3, Surface Laptop 6/3/2/1, Surface Go 4/3/2/1, Sruface Book, 3-Port PD, QC, PPS, Gallium Nitrogen Fa
description_html:
Sisyphy USB Type C GaN 65W Charger for Microsoft Surface, Surface Pro 10/7/6/5/4/3, Surface Laptop 6/3/2/1, Surface Go 4/3/2/1, Sruface Book, 3-Port PD, QC, PPS, Gallium Nitrogen Fast Charging[2xUSB-C


【Compatible Model】Microsoft Surface Pro 10/3/4/5/6/7, Surface Laptop1/2/3/6, Ruface Book1/2/3, Surface Go1/2/3/4. Compatible with Surface Pro8/9 Laptop4/5, but due to technical restrictions the system will show "slow charging q connected" so you can work and enjoy the same time as usual

(Maximum output of 39W for charging Surface devices in this set) Please make sure to charge your Surface using the USB-C 1 port. Surface devices only support 15V voltage input, there are two kinds of charging power, 15V 2.6A and 15V 4A. Typically, the 65W USB-C charger is rated at 20V 3A and does not have 15V 4A output. The 65W USB-C charger will not reach 15V 4A charging output. Therefore, the maximum output to your Surface device is 15V 2.6A (39W) with this charger set

【Using Advanced GaN Technology】 The USB-C charger is smaller and weighs only 110g, 60% lighter and 50% smaller than the original Surface 45w power adapter. Using GaN material can greatly improve charging efficiency. It also reduces heat. With only one GaN charger that is compact and fast charging, you can use the surface charging cable or C2C cable when you are on a business trip, and it can handle most phone and laptop charging problems

【Support Multi-Protocol, Support up to 65W output for most USB-C devices】USB-C 1 supports PD3.0 and PD2.0, USB-C 2 supports PD3.0, PD2.0, PPS (depending on the technical limitations, only USB-C 2 supports PPS 3.3V-11V/5A) USB-A port supports QC3.0, QC2.0, SCP, FCP, AFC etc. USB-C 1 (or USB-C2) ports alone output: 5V/3A, 9V/3A, 12V/3A, 15V/3A, 20V/3.25A max. USB-C 1+USB-C 2 Simultaneous Output: 45W+18W [63W] USB-C 1+USB-A Simultaneous Output: 45W+18W [63W] USB-C 2+USB-A Simultaneous Output: 5V/4.8A [24W] USB-C 1+ (USB-C2+USB-A) simultaneous output is 45W+(15W) [60W total maximum]

PSE Certified, 1 year warranty: PSE certified, UL listed, CE / FCC / RoHS certified. Equipped with multiple protection systems such as overcurrent protection, overheating and short circuit protection, so you can use it for a long time. We offer 1 year warranty service, so you can buy with confidence. If you have any questions during use, please contact us
